usage_context: Commuting student; frequent app switching; unreliable Wi-Fi
scenario_response: I only have a few minutes. I want to return to the same board.
design_concern: Offline access; exact-board resume; story skipping

usage_context: Student who deliberately replays puzzles and compares personal bests
scenario_response: If I undo, why did the counter go up?
design_concern: Explain Undo cost; compare whole attempts; skip previously read dialogue

usage_context: Student who shares puzzles with a friend whose free time differs
scenario_response: We cannot play together at the same time. Can I send a code?
design_concern: Invitation code; server deadline; accepted status; identity versus backup

usage_context: Student uses personal music and enlarged text; calls may interrupt play
scenario_response: I keep my own music on, but a push sound would help.
design_concern: Independent Music/SFX controls; visible labels; paused restore
